```go
func (d *Deps) CanAccess(uid *uint32, s *model.Secret) bool
```

CanAccess reports whether the caller with local Unix user uid \(nil = unknown\) may access s. access\_mode=machine: always. access\_mode=owner: root, or the secret's owner; secrets without an owner are root\-only, and unknown callers are denied.

<a name="Deps.Resolve"></a>
### func \(\*Deps\) [Resolve](<https://github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium/blob/main/internal/sm/sm.go#L153>)

```go
func (d *Deps) Resolve(ctx context.Context, region, secretID string) (*model.Secret, error)
```

Resolve finds the secret a SecretId refers to in region. SecretId may be a name, a full ARN, or a partial ARN \(ARN without the 6\-character suffix\). Deleted \(scheduled\) secrets ARE returned; each operation decides how to treat them. Not found → ResourceNotFoundException.

<a name="Replicator"></a>
## type [Replicator](<https://github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium/blob/main/internal/sm/sm.go#L46-L49>)

Replicator manages replicas of PRIMARY secrets.

Sync propagates a primary's state to its replicas. Operations call it after every successful mutation of a secret with len\(Replicas\) \> 0 \(passing the stored result\). Replication failures are recorded on the replica status by the implementation; Sync returns an error only for internal failures, which callers log and ignore \(AWS reports replication failures through ReplicationStatus, not on the write\).

AddReplicas validates and creates replicas of the stored primary \(region \+ ARN\) and returns the updated primary plus the ReplicationStatus list to put in the response. It is what ReplicateSecretToRegions and CreateSecret with AddReplicaRegions \(after the secret is stored\) both call. Validation failures are \*apierr.Error.

```go
type Replicator interface {
    Sync(ctx context.Context, primary *model.Secret) error
    AddReplicas(ctx context.Context, region, primaryARN string, add []ReplicaRegion, forceOverwrite bool) (*model.Secret, []model.ReplicationStatus, error)
}
```

<a name="Validator"></a>
## type [Validator](<https://github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium/blob/main/internal/sm/validate.go#L19>)

Validator collects service\-model constraint violations \(required, length, range, pattern\) and reports them as one ValidationException in AWS's format. Member names are written as AWS writes them in these messages: lowerCamelCase of the member \(e.g. "secretId"\).

```
v := sm.Validator{}
v.Required("secretId", in.SecretId != nil)
v.Length("secretId", in.SecretId, 1, 2048)
if err := v.Err(); err != nil { return nil, err }
```

```go
type Validator struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```
